extracted.intended_audience: general readers and students of 19th-century American slave narratives and historical memoirs
extracted.subtask_description: Prose excerpt from a 19th-century slave narrative describing daily life, labor, rituals, and abuses on Southern plantations; useful as a model or primary-source example for readers and writers studying historical slave memoirs and realist nonfiction. Focuses on sensory detail, social conditions, and moral commentary rather than prescriptive guidance.
